transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we dive into the design review, I want to make sure we're all on the same page about the courtyard set for Soundstage 3. We have two options on the table — a masonry courtyard or a modular painted-timber courtyard. Our approved construction budget is $180,000, and fabrication can't begin until we've completed this review. I'll be making the final approval decision on the construction plan, so I need thorough input from all of you. Let's start with the structural report, then move through permits, stunts, and insurance. Who'd like to kick things off?

transcript.text: I need to share the results of my load test from yesterday. The masonry courtyard design would exceed Soundstage 3's 600 kilograms-per-square-meter floor limit, so it's not viable from a structural standpoint. The modular painted-timber design does pass — but only if we install a 30-millimeter load-spreading deck. I should note my written report is still in the engineering queue and hasn't been formally distributed yet.

Whatever courtyard design we go with, we need to make sure this lane can be accommodated.
